description: Get usage/throughput stats for one catalog entity — bytes & docs read/written (both directions), usage_seconds, warnings/errors/failures, and txn_count — per time grain. Optionally bound by a timestamp range. Estuary control-plane view catalog_stats. PostgREST: GET /catalog_stats.

catalog_name.description: The exact catalog name to report stats for.

grain.description: Time grain of each stats row (default daily).

ts_end.description: Filter: stats at/before this ISO 8601 timestamp (ts lte).

ts_start.description: Filter: stats at/after this ISO 8601 timestamp (ts gte).

name: estuary_get_catalog_stats
title: Get catalog stats
